Monotonic stack of indices; pop on warmer day.

For daily temps basic I will maintain a stack of days waiting.

```python
def daily(T):
    out = [0] * len(T)
    stack = []
    for i, t in enumerate(T):
        while stack and T[stack[-1]] < t:
            j = stack.pop()
            out[j] = i - j
        stack.append(i)
    return out
```
